menu.comment: Anchored panels that open from the top nav — the account menu, the notification popover, the feedback trigger. NAMED, NOT INVENTED: this is the literal those three already carried before the scale existed.

drawer.comment: The sidebar's off-canvas drawer and its scrim, at or below 480px. Above the anchored panels because the drawer covers the whole viewport including the bar they hang from.

modal.comment: ⚠️ MUST EQUAL TWO THINGS AT ONCE, AND A VITEST CASE HOLDS THEM TOGETHER: the modal backdrop's own rule, and the base the inert stack raises each open backdrop from by its depth. A scale that drifts from the code it describes is worse than no scale, because it reads as authoritative.

tooltip.comment: Above any realistic modal stack (the base plus its depth) and below the toasts. A tooltip is not a surface at a distance from the page — it is an annotation glued to its trigger, so it must paint over whatever contains that trigger, including a dialog. That is why its paint order and its shadow tier disagree; see the elevation table.

toast.comment: The toast host. Highest by design: a toast must read above an open modal, and the host is the one surface exempt from the inert stack so it keeps announcing while a dialog owns the page.
